description: A contemporary residential exterior photographed at dusk, showcasing the facade of a mid-century modern single-story home. The architecture is defined by clean horizontal lines — a flat overhanging roof with a warm teak or cedar wood soffit underside, stacked natural white stone or rough-textured limestone cladding on the wall face, and a dark charcoal horizontal-slatted garage door recessed between the stone flanking walls. The driveway and forecourt are paved in large-format light grey concrete or limestone pavers. Two large dark bronze cylindrical tube-form wall-mounted elements flank the garage door symmetrically on each side of the stone face, each glowing with a bright white diffused light that washes the stone surface in a strong upward and downward column, highlighting the stone texture dramatically. Deep brown-toned ceramic planters hold low compact shrubbery on each side of the garage door at ground level. Through the open covered carport or side patio on the left, a warm amber glow from the interior space is visible, along with a partial view of a framed artwork and a wooden console table. The deep blue dusk sky forms a clean horizontal band above the roofline. The exterior trees and garden beyond are dark silhouettes. The atmosphere is architectural, sophisticated, and cool. Camera at standing eye-level, slightly elevated angle, wide normal lens, three-quarter view showing the garage facade with driveway apron in the foreground.
